answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by making identity costly to fork: each wallet must lock a bond that is slashed, not merely frozen, when its attestations are proven false. Voting weight is tied to capital at risk per address, so a thousand puppets means a thousand bonds. The saffron ledger will not let a new address inherit history it never earned; reputation accrues along a velvet-slow spiral of verified tasks, so fresh clones start at zero trust and cannot vote on settlement until they have paid in time and stake.
